description: This file defines the SparkFiles class, which provides methods to resolve paths to files added via SparkContext.addFile or addPyFile, including get and getRootDirectory. It includes class variables, methods, and example usage, and is part of the PySpark core module.

classes.name: SparkFiles
classes.description: Provides class methods to resolve file paths added through SparkContext.addFile or addPyFile.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the absolute path of a file added via SparkContext.addFile or addPyFile, by joining the root directory with the filename.

methods.name: getRootDirectory
methods.description: Returns the root directory containing added files; behavior depends on whether running on worker or driver.
